name: Jewel Mania
summary: Jewel Mania is a classic match-3 puzzle game where players swap sparkling gems across hundreds of colorful levels. Progress through challenging stages filled with frozen blocks, locked tiles, and unique obstacles while earning up to three stars per level. Unlock powerful boosters to clear difficult puzzles and explore vibrant worlds. Perfect for fans of casual puzzle games who love addictive gem-matching action and bright, charming visuals.
